body:
## Why
The board needs a visual surface that requires no token scopes and no second source of truth. A tiny local webapp (like the Hermes dashboard) over the live GitHub backend: columns per status, cards, drawer with attempts/results, and actions that go through the same verbs the CLI uses — so it is authoritative, not a mirror.

## What
- `hkb serve [--port 4666]`: zero-dependency Node http server. One page (inline HTML/CSS/JS, no build step): columns triage|todo|ready|running|blocked|review|done, card = issue title + agent + priority + deps + PR link, drawer = body, kb block, attempts, latest result, log tail link.
- Data: `GET /api/board` reuses `fetchBoard` (one GraphQL query); poll every 30 s with ETag; `POST /api/tasks/:n/<verb>` routes to the same functions as the CLI (promote, unblock, block, request-changes, archive, comment).
- Drag-drop between columns maps to the legal verbs only; illegal moves are rejected with the reason.
- No auth (binds 127.0.0.1 only, like Hermes); print a warning if --host is set to anything else.

## Done when
`hkb serve` shows this repo's live board and `hkb dispatch --loop` activity is visible without refresh beyond the poll.
title: hkb serve: local web dashboard over the GitHub backend (Hermes-style board)
